meta.model: ecmwf_ifs025 — the ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg DETERMINISTIC run (one member), served by the Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, whose archive for this model starts January 2024
meta.variables: precipitation_previous_day1, precipitation_previous_day2, precipitation_previous_day3, precipitation_previous_day4, precipitation_previous_day5, precipitation_previous_day6, precipitation_previous_day7 (hourly mm, summed to Africa/Lagos calendar days)

period.months: April to November of every year the archive covers

meta.cells: 68 IMERG 0.1 deg cell centres, same as the live forecast
meta.observations: events/rain_history_grid_daily.json (NASA GPM IMERG daily totals per cell)
meta.flood_days: events/flood_days.json; a cell matches a flood day when a reported area lies within 5 km
meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); ECMWF IFS data (c) ECMWF; NASA IMERG open data
meta.caveat: ROUGH GUIDE ONLY: this hindcast scores a single deterministic ECMWF IFS run per lead time, not the 51-member ensemble the live forecast uses. A single run is noisier than an ensemble median, and a storm placed one cell off counts as a miss. Treat these numbers as an early estimate until the live archive (events/forecast/scores.json, score_forecasts.py) has enough days of its own.
meta.method: For each day of April-November 2024-2026 covered by the archive and every cell, the day total forecast at lead times 1-7 days is compared with the IMERG observed total: hits, misses and false alarms at the 40 mm threshold. A reported flood day is counted as flagged when the forecast for its lead day reached the threshold in at least one cell within 5 km of a reported area. The false-alarm share is the fraction of forecast-40 mm cell-days with no flood reported within 5 km of that cell.
